## Constant and field details

<a id="QuadTweenEquation-constant-IN"></a>

### IN

`QuadTweenEquation IN` 

Starts slowly, with a power of 2.

<a id="QuadTweenEquation-constant-OUT"></a>

### OUT

`QuadTweenEquation OUT` 

Ends slowly, with a power of 2.

<a id="QuadTweenEquation-constant-IN_OUT"></a>

### IN_OUT

`QuadTweenEquation IN_OUT` 

Starts and ends slowly, with a power of 2.
